messages.subject: Re: Duplicate-looking accounts
messages.body:
The similarity key tells us which names might confuse a human. It doesn't tell us who submitted them. We already have verified owner IDs. Which ID does a shared entry return when Support asks for the account?

One more thing: the key will always give the same result for the same spelling, but several spellings can give that result. We cannot invert it to recover either name.

messages.subject: Re: Duplicate-looking accounts
messages.body:
Agreed. I meant reconstruct from the retained source records. The diagnostic can locate a bucket, but the export should require a match to each verified original.

Audit can see lengths, scripts, and a limited byte comparison from before the merge. That evidence is independent of the similarity key.
